QuestInfo.name: Moren's Second Round of Teaching
QuestInfo.0: I think I have gotten quite familiar with producing items, and I am sure Moren would be shocked to see my prowess in it. Right at that time, Moren called me and told me if I ever had anything to do in Magatia, make sure to stop by and see him.
QuestInfo.1:
I wound up heading to Magatia after seeing Moren's message. As soon as I saw him, however, instead of a hearty hug, he gave me a huge scolding. Apparently, he saw one of the items I made at the Free Market, and he was so disgusted by my poor quality of work that he vowed to set me straight by giving me a test.
The test is actually making an Intermediate Monster Crystal. Hmmm... this is quite intense.

#i4260003# #t4260003# #b#c4260003# / 1
QuestInfo.2: Moren gave me a lecture on how I had become complacent, and told me I had to start again from scratch. After passing his test by successfully creating the Intermediate Monster Crystal, he let me go, and I realized my item-producing skills have gotten that much better as a result of his words.

0.0: Hey! What is this?! I was so flabbergasted by this that I had to compose myself before calling you! What happened?!\r\n#b#L0#What did happen??#l
0.1: Here, take a look! I bought this item from the Free Market in Ludibrium this morning. Didn't you make this? I know you did!\r\n#b#L0#Yes, I did make this... and... what's the problem?#l
0.2: Are you still unaware what exactly is wrong here? Look! This is ludicrous! What were you thinking when you made this and actually sold this? This is basically the quickest way to destroy your reputation! This is unacceptable! You'll need some boot camp training in order to get your head straight! Are you ready?

yes.0: I want you to make the Monster Crystal again, since it serves as one of the very basic items for item-production. I want you to make the Intermediate Monster Crystal! I'll need to look over the item and personally sign it off in order for you to pass this test! What happens if you don't pass? Of course you'll do this until you pass! ! Now, I want you to go make one right now! Don't do it half-heartedly!

no.0: Do you not understand how serious this really is?
